files.purpose: New module. Thin dispatcher (sync, single try/catch per sink) for the normalized request-completion contract. Accepts one immutable RequestContext and routes it to MetricsAggregators, RequestHistory, MetricsStore, and AnalyticsEngine through injected accessor callbacks; optional recordError method documented for Task 4 wiring. Never a state owner; never persists a second copy.

recordError: stub for Task 4 (returns early when no error store wired)
